Messages.Author: Marc René Delhalle
Messages.Body:
Hi, it´s me again!

First Question: Wild Hunt and Blood Hunt are exchangeable.
Is there really _no_ difference between both ?
For Example, what happens if a Blood Hunt is called on Muaziz ??
(Yep, this was already asked 11/96 by James Hamblin, but I didn´t
find a straight & good answer to this question on DejaNews.)

Second: Pulled Fangs can be used, when a minion inflicts more damage
than the opposing minion. Does the Damage from let´s say Carrion
Crows have any effect on Pulled Fangs ? How about Retainer ?

Third (It is a stupid question, I`m afraid): Can Reaction
Cards be played on Minions, which are controlled by another
Methusalah ? E.g. Wake with Evenings Freshness ?
The Card states "Only usable by a tapped minion".
And if, how about spending intercept with Enhanced Senses?

Thank you!

Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:
Marc René Delhalle wrote:
> First Question: Wild Hunt and Blood Hunt are exchangeable.
> Is there really _no_ difference between both ?

Correct. They are two names for the same thing.

> For Example, what happens if a Blood Hunt is called on Muaziz ??
> (Yep, this was already asked 11/96 by James Hamblin, but I didn´t
> find a straight & good answer to this question on DejaNews.)

Neither Blood Hunts nor Wild Hunts may be called on Muaziz, by card
text.

> Second: Pulled Fangs can be used, when a minion inflicts more damage
> than the opposing minion. Does the Damage from let´s say Carrion
> Crows have any effect on Pulled Fangs ? How about Retainer ?

Retainers' damage is not counted when determining if Pulled Fangs can
be played. All other damage that the minions' inflict is counted,
including Carrion Crows.

> Third (It is a stupid question, I`m afraid): Can Reaction
> Cards be played on Minions, which are controlled by another
> Methusalah ? E.g. Wake with Evenings Freshness ?

No.

> The Card states "Only usable by a tapped minion".
> And if, how about spending intercept with Enhanced Senses?

Moot.

--
